title: Naked yoga class
content: I had a dream the other night that I walked into a yoga class and everyone was naked. I explained to the teacher that I didn't realize it was a nude class. She encouraged me to come back for another class where everyone was fully clothed. I left the room, which was in a large multistory building in a downtown area. That's all I remember. It felt like a mall dream but in a different location than I'd been in before.
